findings.description: The RDS instance explicitly sets storage_encrypted = false, so database storage and automated backups/snapshots are not protected by encryption at rest if underlying storage is accessed or exposed.

The database password is interpolated into EC2 user data and written to /var/www/inc/dbinfo.inc. User data is available through the instance metadata service to processes with instance access and is retained in Terraform state, exposing a long-lived database credential.

The parameter group does not set MySQL require_secure_transport=ON, while the application uses mysqli_connect without SSL/TLS options. The database credential and application data can therefore be transmitted without enforced transport encryption between the application and RDS.

The policy grants every S3, EC2, and RDS action on every resource to the application instance role. Compromise of the attached EC2 instance would grant broad control of compute and databases and unrestricted access to S3 resources available in the account.

MySQL access is allowed from the entire VPC CIDR rather than only the application security group or specific approved workloads. Any compromised or untrusted workload in the VPC can attempt to reach the database service.

The database security group permits all protocols and ports to every IPv4 destination. This removes egress network segmentation and enables unrestricted outbound communications from the database network interface.
